item.title: Singapore hosts top aviation show
item.description: Asia’s largest aviation industry exhibition opened in Singapore on Tuesday, showcasing ambitious regional growth goals and innovations in both civil and defense aviation, Azernews reports.

item.title: Is water new gold? Why investors are turning to water companies
item.description: For investors, water represents a rare category of asset: one driven by necessity rather than economic cycles. Demand for water remains stable regardless of market conditions, making water-related companies, particularly utilities among the more defensive segments of the infrastructure sector. Rising population, urbanization, climate pressure, and growing industrial demand from sectors such as data centers, clean energy, and advanced manufacturing continue to underpin long-term growth. item.title: Spain to ban social media for under-16s
item.description: Spain is planning to ban access to social media for minors under the age of 16, requiring platforms to introduce mandatory age-verification systems, Azernews reports.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev held expanded meeting with Armenian Prime Minister in Abu Dhabi
item.description: An expanded meeting between President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev and Prime Minister of the Republic of Armenia Nikol Pashinyan has commenced in Abu Dhabi, Azernews reports.

item.title: Azeri Light oil price rises to $69.80 per barrel at Italy’s Augusta port
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude oil delivered on a CIF basis to Italy’s Augusta port rose by $0.08, or 0.11 percent, compared to the previous session, reaching $69.80 per barrel, Azernews reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan expects inflation to stay within target in 2026–2027
item.description: Under the baseline scenario, annual inflation is projected to remain within the target range by the end of 2026 and throughout 2027, Azernews reports, citing the Central Bank of Azerbaijan (CBA).

item.title: SOCAR plans to drill 80 wells and conduct over 500 operations this year
item.description: A total of 80 wells are planned to be drilled this year, along with more than 500 well operations, according to SOCAR.

item.title: Azerbaijan Int'l badminton tournament begins in Baku
item.description: Azerbaijan International 2026 Badminton Tournament has officially got underway, Azernews reports.
